look_here_first: LOOK HERE FIRST: Look for a robust, upright grass with broad, flat, often pale-midribbed leaf blades and a conspicuous terminal panicle made of many short branches bearing paired spikelets. Panicles vary from open and branching to compact in cultivated varieties. Check the broad leaves and clustered grain heads together; do not identify it solely by panicle density.
